chunks: And what prevented Us from sending signs was only that the earlier people had rejected them as lies. We gave Thamud the she-camel as a clear sign, but they treated her unjustly; and We send signs only to deter.

key_terms.مُبْصِرَةً: clear/visionary (a sign that makes the truth clear)

ai.seo_question: Why did God send signs to some nations and withhold them from others?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Isra clarifies that divine signs are withheld not due to incapacity but as a consequence of prior nations' persistent denial, specifically citing the Thamud's mistreatment of the she-camel as a pivotal test. The term 'takhwifan' (as a warning/deterrent) underscores the purpose of these miracles to awaken the heedless, a concept emphasized by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Majlisi in linking historical precedent to the Prophet Muhammad's mission.
